fields.name: enableLogging
fields.description: Enable logging when true

fields.name: mqttTopicPrefix
fields.description: MQTT topic prefix (written by CLI, not used by script)

fields.name: preferredDeviceId
fields.description: Which device ID should run (actual Shelly device ID). Script compares this to its own ID

fields.name: pro3DeviceId
fields.description: Pro3 device ID (for MQTT subscriptions - cross-device status tracking)

fields.name: pro1DeviceId
fields.description: Pro1 device ID (for MQTT subscriptions - cross-device status tracking)

fields.name: preferredSpeed
fields.description: Speed: 'eco', 'mid', 'high', 'max'. Maps to switches based on device capabilities

fields.name: ecoSpeed
fields.description: Pro3 switch ID for eco/low speed (0, 1, or 2)

fields.name: midSpeed
fields.description: Pro3 switch ID for mid speed (0, 1, or 2)

fields.name: highSpeed
fields.description: Pro3 switch ID for high speed (0, 1, or 2)

fields.name: nightRunDurationMs
fields.description: Night run duration in ms (written by CLI, not used by script)

fields.name: graceDelayMs
fields.description: Cross-device grace delay in ms (minimum 10000)

fields.name: temperatureThreshold
fields.description: Temperature threshold (°C) for summer mode (day schedule)

fields.name: poolVolume
fields.description: Pool volume in m³

fields.name: turnover
fields.description: Daily turnover target (number of full pool volumes to filter per day)

fields.name: maxFlowRate
fields.description: Pump max flow rate in m³/h at max RPM

fields.name: maxRpm
fields.description: Pump rated max RPM

fields.name: ecoRpm
fields.description: Variator RPM setting for eco speed

fields.name: midRpm
fields.description: Variator RPM setting for mid speed

fields.name: highRpm
fields.description: Variator RPM setting for high speed

fields.name: maxTemp
fields.description: Temperature (°C) at which run time reaches one full turnover

fields.name: solarEnabled
fields.description: Enable solar-driven start/stop via the daemon's solar-available MQTT event

fields.name: solarStartThresholdW
fields.description: Available solar power (W) required to trigger a solar start

fields.name: solarStopThresholdW
fields.description: Available solar power (W) below which a solar-driven run stops

fields.name: solarStartDelayMs
fields.description: Solar must hold above start threshold this long (ms) before starting

fields.name: solarStopDelayMs
fields.description: Solar must hold below stop threshold this long (ms) before stopping

fields.name: solarMinTurnover
fields.description: Soft-stop target (pool volumes/day); solar keeps running past this while solar remains available

fields.name: solarMaxTurnover
fields.description: Hard ceiling (pool volumes/day); pump always stops (and won't solar-start) once reached

fields.name: solarStaleMs
fields.description: Treat myhome/energy/solar/available as stale (fall back to schedule only) after this long (ms) without a message
